page_title: ATA 0-0 CAG | Atalanta v Cagliari 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Matteo Marchetti is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Florinel Coman (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+5' The referee shows a yellow card to Isak Hien (Atalanta). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+3' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+1' Here's the change. Roberto Piccoli leaves the pitch and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.

90+1' That was close by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Elia Caprile (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.

90' Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile is equal to it and makes an easy save. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
87' Ederson (Atalanta) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
86' Atalanta take a short corner kick.

86' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.

84' Atalanta slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
82' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
80' Cagliari showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atalanta are taking a throw-in.
79' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Deiola is replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
78' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
76' Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
74' Substitution. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has come on for Ibrahim Sulemana.
73' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Good work from Cagliari as they win a corner.
72' Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) meets a cross inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
69' Cagliari are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
67' Here is a change. Marco Brescianini is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Ederson (Atalanta).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mattia Felici trots off the pitch and is replaced by Florinel Coman (Cagliari).
66' Wonderful movement by Cagliari. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
64' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
63' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
62' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
60' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
59' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

58' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
57' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vanja Vlahovic (Atalanta) will replace Mateo Retegui.
56' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Marco Palestra (Atalanta) replaces Juan Cuadrado.
55' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Atalanta.
54' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

52' Atalanta are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
52' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
49' Atalanta show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
46' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
46' Half-time substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
41' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

38' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
38' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

38' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
36' The corner kick from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

35' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile made a superb athletic save to deny him.
34' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' A long ball forward to Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is intercepted.
33' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
32' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
31' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a throw-in.
29' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Mateo Retegui (Atalanta). Atalanta have a corner.

26' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
23' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
22' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
19' The Cagliari players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
15' A cross from Stefan Posch (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
14' The ball is cleared after Mattia Felici (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
12' Atalanta are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
11' Cagliari show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

8' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Atalanta will take a throw-in.
6' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Stefan Posch (Atalanta) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marchetti signals a set piece.
3' Atalanta are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

1' Cagliari slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
